newsitem.title: UK: Thames sees London coop unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Thames sees London coop unchanged.

text.p: British water and sewerage firm Thames Water said it saw no change in its cooperation with regional electricity company (Rec) London Electricity, which has agreed to a 1.267 billion pound takeover by Entergy of the U.S.
"We don't think there is any reason why (the collaboration) should be affected," said a spokesman on Wednesday.

Sporadic speculation that Thames Water and London Electricity might merge to form a multi-utility has largely been discounted by the two companies who maintain cooperation on various joint developments.
At interim results in October, Thames managing director Bill Alexander said a merger was not on the cards. "We considered that and ruled it out some time ago," he said.
